fusions.name: Cast Mesh
fusions.desc: Hurls a weighted mesh that deals 12 damage and stuns the target for 1 second.

fusions.name: Drawn Seine
fusions.desc: Draws a line of mesh 6 tiles long that stands for 6 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward and dealing 28 damage that ignores resistances to each enemy it catches.

fusions.name: Gather the Slack
fusions.desc: Pulls up to 5 enemies within 7 tiles onto you for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Knot Tied Off
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 4 stamina. Once every 6 seconds.
